plainTranslation: A's dreams meets B's drive. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
summaryDeep: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
